description: This file defines the XPUEvent class, a wrapper around SYCL events for XPU devices, including methods for recording, querying, timing, and synchronization of events within the c10::xpu namespace.

classes.name: XPUEvent
classes.description: A movable, non-copyable wrapper around SYCL events for XPU devices, supporting recording, timing, and synchronization.

methods.name: XPUEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with optional timing.

methods.name: ~XPUEvent
methods.description: Destructor that traces event deletion if tracing is enabled.

methods.name: operator sycl::event&()
methods.description: Conversion operator to access the underlying SYCL event.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the event if created.

methods.name: isCreated
methods.description: Checks if the event has been created.

methods.name: device_index
methods.description: Returns the device index associated with the event.

methods.name: event
methods.description: Returns a reference to the underlying SYCL event.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Checks if the event has completed execution.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records the event on the current XPU stream.

methods.name: recordOnce
methods.description: Records the event once on a specified stream if not already recorded.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Makes a stream wait until the event is completed.

methods.name: elapsed_time
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between this event and another, if both are completed and timing is enabled.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Waits for the event to complete, with tracing if enabled.
